posts.title: ImageViewer 2.0: now on Windows, macOS and Linux
posts.description: ImageViewer started as my answer to a slow, chatty Windows Photos app: open a folder, get out of the way, show me the pictures. It did that well, but only on Windows. I have a confession to make. I've not used Windows in a couple of years now. My personal devices now run Linux, and my work laptop is a MacBook Pro. I did miss having a simple image viewer however.
